projects.title: Trip Planner
projects.description: Plan multi-day trips on an open 3D map with routes, automatic weather, packing lists and credited day photos. Edit by hand or import a sourced JSON itinerary. Includes Sardegna and a photo-rich Lisbon, Sintra and Porto demo.
projects.privacy: No account or API key. Trips stay in this browser. Map, place, route and weather requests go directly to public providers. Photo lookup sends stop coordinates to Wikipedia and Wikimedia Commons; images show linked author, licence and source.

projects.title: Field Atlas
projects.description: An interactive Italy map demo with synthetic vibration readings, asset selection, and local inspection marks.
projects.privacy: Map tiles and elevation come directly from their named providers. Asset readings are simulated; inspection marks stay in this browser.

projects.title: Snake Arcade
projects.description: A responsive arcade game with keyboard and touch controls, pause, replay, and a browser-local high score.
projects.privacy: No account or app API key. Your best score is stored in this browser.
